prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE professional ORIGINAL hunting-equipment family concept sheet for VEILBOUND HUNTERS. Landscape 3:2, warm ivory background, no scenery, no watermark, restrained realistic hand-painted materials, aged bronze fittings and dark leather. Reference image 1 is the approved art direction. Reference image 2 is the source creature; derive materials and asymmetry but do NOT draw a creature or turn the human into that creature.
COMPOSITION: LEFT 30 percent: one complete adult neutral human mannequin wearing all five armor regions, head to boots fully visible, relaxed upright stance, empty hands, front three-quarter view. Practical closed clothing, MANDATORY LOW HELMET fully covering the crown and forehead, NO visible hair and no bare head, readable joints. Never omit head armor. RIGHT 70 percent: exactly SEVEN cleanly separated weapon groups in two rows, each complete with generous gaps, no cropping. Top row 01-04; bottom row 05-07. Only text is small labels 01,02,03,04,05,06,07 below corresponding groups. Each group keeps its recognizable form:
01 enormous broad single-edge slab greatsword; 02 compact SINGLE-EDGE sword AND a separate shield; 03 long-handled heavy blunt maul with a CLOSED HARD BONE impact face, NOT a drum; 04 TWO matching short blades; 05 long slim curved single-edge sword; 06 straight long lance AND a separate tall shield; 07 bow with an actual string, small separate aiming ring, AND one arrow. No firearms, scythes, axes, duplicate groups, magical floating parts. Armor mannequin holds none of these.
SOURCE SERIES 078: サルピノク / 帷鋏蟹. Native grade: 4. This sheet shows ONLY this native-grade design. Palette: 灰緑 / 暗灰紫 / 青銅.
Armor silhouette: 灰緑の縦板を左肩だけ高くし、右籠手は太く下へ伸ばす。毒溝は暗い灰紫で短く区切る。
Armor five regions: head: 帷鋏甲の低い額縁と開いた頬; chest: 左肩だけに高い縦板、胴中央は薄い灰緑; arms: 右籠手を太く下へ伸ばし手首で止める; waist: 六脚靭膜の短い腰布と小さな圧露容器; legs: 脛を細い蟹脚甲で左右同じ高さに包む
Distinct weapons: 01 帷鋏の縦板を刃背へ置く厚剣; 02 毒溝鋏芯の片刃と縦帷の盾; 03 鋏芯を閉じた硬質の横長槌; 04 鋏の内縁を二本の短い反り刃へ削る; 05 霧帷縁を低い峰の一筋にした太刀; 06 六脚芯の直槍と左帷甲の高い盾; 07 圧露管を握り裏へ収めた細い弓身
Preserve the specifically stated anatomical LEFT and RIGHT of the WEARER. Keep shoulder and waist protrusions restrained for movement. Helmets, both hands, boots, blade tips, bowstring, shields and spear point fully inside the canvas. Original visual language, avoid any recognizable existing franchise designs. Clear fabrication joints, few broad forms, no dense filigree. This is concept art, not a precise orthographic production drawing.
The style board is ONLY a rendering style reference. Do not reuse the stone armor, bare-headed man or stone weapon material from it. The creature materials and the species-specific armor silhouette dominate this sheet.
FRAMING: put every object entirely within the inner 85 percent of the canvas with at least 80 pixels empty margin on every outer edge. Scale down the largest sword, spear and human as needed. Every blade tip and every boot must be visible with clear empty space around it; never touch or crop at the canvas boundary.
referenceRoles: source creature material and silhouette reference

review.scope: 初登場級の系列比較原画。各級別の画像ではなく、級差はgradeAppearanceで指示。
review.notes: 全7武器群・防具5部位を視認。装着者左肩の高い縦板と右籠手の厚い甲、自由な手指を確認。灰紫の短い溝と腰の小容器、弓握りの圧露管あり。槌は閉じた鋏芯形の硬質面。剣先、槍先、足先の欠損なし。断岳剣上端の余白80px未達。縦肩板の横方向可動と右手首の干渉は別図で要確認。
